blocks.text: It inhibits fibrinolysis and reduces mortality from bleeding when given early in PPH.

content_groups.group_title: Q10. When would you consider balloon tamponade?

blocks.text: Persistent bleeding, particularly from presumed uterine atony, despite appropriate uterotonics and initial management.

content_groups.group_title: Q11. When would you proceed to surgery?

blocks.text: When bleeding is ongoing or life-threatening despite appropriate medical and mechanical measures, or when there is a structural cause requiring surgery.

content_groups.group_title: Q12. When would hysterectomy be necessary?

blocks.text: Uncontrolled life-threatening haemorrhage despite other measures, or pathology such as severe placenta accreta spectrum where hysterectomy is required.
